english.title: Buy / sell the goodwill of a medical practice in contravention of a prohibition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sold the goodwill of a medical practice, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME AND ADDRESS OF MEDICAL PRACTICE..) of **(..SPECIFY PRACTITIONER..), a person to whom section 259(2) to (4) applied, when

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

(C)_[continued to provide or perform the services mentioned]_
(D)_[had carried on the practice in a relevant area]
(E)_[continued to provide or perform the services mentioned and had carried on the practice in a relevant area]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 259 of and Schedule 21 to the National Health Service Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
bought / sold
the goodwill of a medical practice
which it was unlawful to sell
by virtue of s 259

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Indictment: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding such amount as will in the court's opinion secure that he derives no benefit from the offence and a further amount of £500.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
